function.description: Send a message — and any FILES you made — to a chat/recipient on a surface (telegram/email/slack/discord/signal/whatsapp/feishu/dingtalk/x). Attach with media_paths, one call per file; a path in text is NOT a delivery. Owner/allowlisted only. action=posts/delete: name/delete my own posts.
function.name: message

parameters.description:
Send a message to a specific chat/recipient on a specific surface.
Only owner + owner-allowlisted targets are permitted (default-deny).

action.description: send | reply | posts (list what I posted, with ledger rows) | delete (my OWN post, owner's instruction only, telegram <48h: give post=<row>, or message_id + target, or last=N + target)

last.description: delete/posts: the N most recent posts to target

media_paths.description: Optional file paths (MUST resolve inside THIS session's workspace) to send as media alongside the text — images go as photos, other files as document attachments. Paths outside the workspace are rejected (the whole call fails). Only delivered on surfaces that support media (currently telegram, email); other surfaces still get the text, plus an honest note that media wasn't sent.

message_id.description: delete: the message id in target's chat

post.description: delete: the post-ledger row a send receipt named

surface.description: Surface id, e.g. 'telegram', 'email', 'whatsapp'. Omit to use the owner's primary surface. 'email' sets a fixed subject line (a reply keeps the thread); to choose the subject use email_send.

target.description: Recipient/chat id on that surface (chat id, @user, or email address). Omit, or pass 'owner', to message the owner.

text.description: Message body to send (unused for delete/posts)
